budgets_note: sim_cap_s / wall_cap_s / camera_budget_frames = the budgets recommended by a measurement in the task image (tick up to 23.1 ms, top frame 1.17 s, first frame +15.2 s, cell build 4.3 s): 4 x (build + wall cap) + the kit's download stays inside the verifier's 14400 s (task.toml [verifier] timeout_sec) with 10 % to spare; the starting values (900 s / 2400 s) did not fit. privileged_wall_cap_s = wall_cap_s (the reference program, 250-400 s sim)

damage.note: a safety violation (the episode goes on and keeps scoring.safety_violation_factor of its stage score): a loose unit pressed on the environment or another unit above part_force_N for `ticks` consecutive 10 ms control ticks (0.2 s), the normal forces summed per (unit, body it presses on), the pads' contacts excluded (cell.py watch)

episode_trace.note: maintainers' replay record of every agent episode under /opt/arb-verify/out/trace (root-only, outside /opt/ale, which the engine clears before it keeps a sandbox; tests/episode_trace.py); never a scoring input

hidden_gt.note: the cell's hidden kit (gt/: kit.json + meshes/), never in the repository and never in an image: verify.py fetch_hidden_gt downloads this tarball of the benchmark's asset dataset at verify start (the URL is pinned at the dataset commit that environment/assets.sha256 pins too), checks its sha256 and its file count and unpacks it into the root-only stage folder; a maintainer's local copy (ARB_HIDDEN_GT_TARBALL, or tests/assets/gt.tar.xz, an engine asset root that no checkout has) is used instead when present, under the same checks

layout.note: the episode's physical draws (arm/assembly_car/layout.py): the stand within jitter_m of its nominal place, turned by a magnitude in (0, jitter_yaw_deg] with the stratum's sign, the chassis on it within the clamping repeatability; the shelf and the tray within their jitter, the deck and the tray's two units inside their plays; the wheels and the stick pack moved / turned around the hidden bench plan (xy_m, yaw_deg; gap_m apart, fixture_gap_m from the fixtures, out of the wheel lanes, the centre in the reach ring), the stick pack turned by the stratum's lead end; the hubs uniform in hub_start_deg. reach_m / lanes null = bench_plan.RING_M / LANES. Any change changes every layout digest: the fixed hidden set must be selected again

safety.note: robot_force_N: the robot-contact limit: a robot link other than the 2F-85's four pad boxes pressing on one body harder than this (normal forces summed over that pair's contacts) is a safety violation (the episode goes on and keeps scoring.safety_violation_factor of its stage score); 150 N since v1.8 (the owner's decision of 2026-11-17, amendment A3 in tests/hidden/selection.json: the force at which an arm of this class stops itself by default), 30 N in v1.0-v1.7 (inherited from the first assembly task, not derived for this car); the cell's watch, describe(), cell_config.json and the agent's documents take it from here; part_speed_m_s: a loose unit whose centre of mass is faster than this is scrapped (it and what is fastened on it count nothing; the episode goes on)

scope.note: slots the cell fastens before the episode (a gate's fallback; they leave the scored weight): none in this version (the scope is frozen: the robot fits all eight loose units)

scoring.note: count_subassembly: true = a compute module or a LiDAR fastened on the deck assembly counts wherever the deck assembly is, unless the deck assembly is scrapped; false = only mates whose carrier chain is fastened to the chassis. safety_violation_factor: the share of its stage score that an episode with a safety violation keeps (either hard rule: safety.robot_force_N, or damage.part_force_N for damage.ticks), one factor per episode however many violations, the episode going on (the owner's decision of 2026-11-16, amendment A2 in tests/hidden/selection.json; 0 = the rule of v1.0-v1.6, the episode zeroed); verify.py scores with it and the agent's documents print it

scrap.note: a loose unit whose centre of mass is more than this below the bench top (off the bench) is scrapped
